title: Writing Vicksburg Blues
summary: He worked on the tune from 1923 with two friends, and renamed it Vicksburg Blues.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Around 19, well, I was fooling around with it since 1923.

Well, we started playing it around, you know, Fairty, Louisiana, Natchez, Mississippi, Tallulah, Louisiana, different places, you know, just Kepa color-vading it, you know. So I named it. Some of the boys tried to make 44 blues out of it, so I just changed the name of it because we made it up. Me and two more boys, Friday and Dale Coe Robert. So I changed the name to Vicksburg Blues, you know, I have to.
